scope: Broad discovery-centered pool for merging with an independently prepared Claude list. Provisional credit pools may exceed three; an award proposal may contain at most three people total. No ranking, probabilities or actual nomination claims.
independence_note: Medicine format and local Chemistry committee roster inspected. Existing Claude Chemistry filenames were observed, but their candidate contents were not read or used.
limitations: Broad coverage is intended, but no longlist can be demonstrably exhaustive. Inclusion is an author judgment, not evidence of an actual nomination.
Scientific claims are source-supported at the draft level. Source excerpts, original-paper authorship, institutional accounts and award citations do not resolve priority or equal credit.
Some sources were available only as search excerpts because direct retrieval was blocked. Full-text and competing-priority checks are needed for shortlisted discoveries.
Living-status review is targeted rather than a complete audit. Known deceased pioneers are historical credit only; independently recheck every proposed final recipient as of the announcement.
Prior-award flags are scope reminders. A previous laureate is not automatically ineligible for a distinct discovery, but already rewarded work must not be presented as new.
Discovery entries with boundary_or_overlap_review status are retained to avoid omissions during the merge; this status is not a probability or numerical rank.
No direct credited-name overlap was found with the eight people in the local Chemistry roster; coauthorship, supervisory and other relationship conflicts were not audited.
Cross-category overlap with Medicine and Physics is intentional. The same discovery should not be counted twice within a merged Chemistry list.

candidates.discovery: Accurate exchange-correlation approximations for practical DFT
candidates.scientific_basis: Hybrid and gradient-based functionals make electronic-structure calculations practically useful.
candidates.rationale: Widely used chemical prediction methods.
candidates.main_reservation: DFT itself won in 1998, and the pool spans different functional constructions.
candidates.attribution_note: Becke’s hybrid lineage differs from the Perdew/Burke/Ernzerhof GGA lineage; choose a coherent scope before selecting three.
prior_award_flags: DFT foundation: Chemistry 1998; substantial overlap review

candidates.discovery: Activity-based protein profiling
candidates.scientific_basis: Reactive probes label active enzyme sites to measure function in complex biological samples.
candidates.rationale: A general chemical method for probing enzyme function and drug engagement.
candidates.main_reservation: The field intersects the bioorthogonal chemistry rewarded in 2022.
candidates.attribution_note: Cravatt’s founding work and Bogyo’s independent protease probes support the pool; final scope should decide whether both lineages are included.
prior_award_flags: Bioorthogonal chemistry: Chemistry 2022; distinguish activity measurement

candidates.discovery: Ambient ionization for direct mass spectrometry of ordinary samples
candidates.scientific_basis: DESI and DART create ions from samples in ambient conditions with little preparation.
candidates.rationale: A useful new analytical capability outside conventional sample handling.
candidates.main_reservation: DESI and DART are different inventions; a single award must justify combining them.
candidates.attribution_note: Cooks/Takáts represent DESI; Cody/Laramée represent DART. Narrow the technology before selecting recipients.
prior_award_flags: Earlier MS ionization: Chemistry 2002; distinct ambient sampling

candidates.discovery: Atom transfer radical polymerization
candidates.scientific_basis: Reversible metal-mediated activation controls radical chain growth and polymer architecture.
candidates.rationale: A general and widely used route to designed macromolecules.
candidates.main_reservation: Multiple independent 1995 discoveries complicate allocation of three places.
candidates.attribution_note: Retain the Wang and Kamigaito contributions alongside the two laboratory leaders; Percec and the complete early author lists merit final review.

candidates.discovery: Atomic force microscopy for nanoscale surfaces and molecules
candidates.scientific_basis: A sensitive force probe maps insulating as well as conducting surfaces.
candidates.rationale: A foundational analytical tool for nanoscale chemistry.
candidates.main_reservation: Physics is plausible, and Binnig already received a prize for STM.
candidates.attribution_note: The Kavli award supports the invention lineage; Quate is historical credit only.
prior_award_flags: Binnig: Physics 1986 for STM; distinct force-probe method

candidates.discovery: Biomolecular phase separation organizing cells
candidates.scientific_basis: Multivalent molecular interactions form dynamic concentrated compartments without membranes.
candidates.rationale: A broadly influential physical principle for cellular organization.
candidates.main_reservation: Phase separation is not the explanation for every reported cellular assembly.
candidates.attribution_note: The joint discovery accounts support Hyman/Brangwynne’s cellular observations and Rosen’s multivalency experiments.

candidates.discovery: Chaperone-assisted folding of proteins
candidates.scientific_basis: ATP-dependent chaperone machinery assists folding and prevents harmful aggregation.
candidates.rationale: A fundamental discovery about how protein chemistry works in cells.
candidates.main_reservation: Also a strong Medicine candidate; distinguish folding machinery from the structure-prediction prize in 2024.
candidates.attribution_note: The Lasker scientific account supports the pair; additional chaperone contributors need scope-specific review.
prior_award_flags: Protein structure prediction/design: Chemistry 2024; distinct cellular folding mechanism

candidates.discovery: Chemical communication and quorum sensing in bacteria
candidates.scientific_basis: Secreted molecular signals coordinate bacterial behavior according to population context.
candidates.rationale: A fundamental discovery of chemical communication between cells.
candidates.main_reservation: Medicine is plausible and early autoinducer discoveries extend beyond this pair.
candidates.attribution_note: The Shaw citation supports the mechanistic pool; final attribution should distinguish founding observations from signal-system discoveries.

candidates.discovery: Chemically amplified polymer resists for semiconductor lithography
candidates.scientific_basis: Photogenerated acid catalytically changes resist solubility and amplifies an exposure signal.
candidates.rationale: A molecular-materials invention underpinning fine semiconductor patterning.
candidates.main_reservation: Materials engineering is prominent and the third original inventor is deceased.
candidates.attribution_note: The Japan Prize supports both living candidates and explicitly credits the late Hiroshi Ito.

candidates.discovery: Copper-catalyzed electrochemical conversion of carbon dioxide
candidates.scientific_basis: Electrode chemistry enables CO2 reduction to hydrocarbons and oxygenated products.
candidates.rationale: A foundational chemical discovery for electrochemical carbon conversion.
candidates.main_reservation: Practical scale, selectivity and energy efficiency remain issues; later catalyst inventors are numerous.
candidates.attribution_note: Hori is the original-discovery pool; a modern process or materials citation would require different sourced recipients.

candidates.discovery: Crystalline sponges for structure determination of difficult small molecules
candidates.scientific_basis: Porous host crystals order absorbed guests for X-ray structural analysis.
candidates.rationale: A specific route around the need to crystallize the target molecule itself.
candidates.main_reservation: Applicability is limited by guest uptake, disorder and data quality; the original paper has a corrigendum.
candidates.attribution_note: The original paper supports Fujita and Inokuma as an initial pool; follow the corrected structural account in final review.
prior_award_flags: Porous coordination materials: Chemistry 2025; distinguish analytical guest-ordering method

candidates.discovery: Dendrimers and convergent synthesis of branched macromolecules
candidates.scientific_basis: Generation-by-generation branching produces molecules with designed size and surface groups.
candidates.rationale: A new controllable class of macromolecular architecture.
candidates.main_reservation: Foundational importance exceeds the maturity of some proposed practical uses.
candidates.attribution_note: Tomalia and Newkome represent early divergent structures; Fréchet represents convergent construction.

candidates.discovery: Design of molecular-sieve catalysts with controlled pores and active sites
candidates.scientific_basis: Designed microporous frameworks impose chemical selectivity through their structures and catalytic sites.
candidates.rationale: A major chemical approach with mature catalytic applications.
candidates.main_reservation: An overly broad citation risks rewarding careers rather than a defined discovery.
candidates.attribution_note: The joint award account supports inclusion, not a resolved Nobel citation; select specific framework or catalyst inventions at shortlisting.

candidates.discovery: Discovery and synthesis of carbon nanotubes
candidates.scientific_basis: Graphitic sheets form nanoscale tubes with distinctive structure and properties.
candidates.rationale: A foundational material discovery and new nanoscale carbon architecture.
candidates.main_reservation: Older tubular-carbon observations and industrial growth methods complicate priority.
candidates.attribution_note: Iijima’s 1991 observations and Bethune’s independent single-wall growth support this initial pool; Endo and earlier microscopy lineages need explicit historical review.
prior_award_flags: Fullerenes: Chemistry 1996 and graphene: Physics 2010; distinguish tubular carbon

candidates.discovery: DNA origami and programmable DNA nanostructures
candidates.scientific_basis: Sequence-specific pairing programs the assembly and folding of nanoscale structures.
candidates.rationale: A general way to construct matter from molecular information.
candidates.main_reservation: The field founder is deceased; origami, algorithmic assembly and 3D design are distinct contributions.
candidates.attribution_note: Rothemund has direct origami authorship; Winfree and Shih are alternatives for a broader citation, not co-inventors of the same 2006 method.

candidates.discovery: DNA-programmed nanoparticle assembly and spherical nucleic acids
candidates.scientific_basis: Surface-bound DNA programs nanoparticle association and supplies new nucleic-acid architectures.
candidates.rationale: A distinct molecular approach to constructing and sensing nanomaterials.
candidates.main_reservation: Particle assembly and biological properties of spherical nucleic acids are separable citations.
candidates.attribution_note: Mirkin is the central initial candidate; Mucic and Storhoff are original-paper alternatives. Alivisatos’s independent DNA-particle assembly lineage needs review for a broader claim.

candidates.discovery: DNA-programmed synthesis and selection of small-molecule libraries
candidates.scientific_basis: DNA directs or records chemical synthesis so molecular libraries can be selected and decoded.
candidates.rationale: A method connecting amplifiable information to synthetic molecular discovery.
candidates.main_reservation: DNA-templated synthesis, DNA routing and encoded-library screening are distinct inventions.
candidates.attribution_note: This initial pool covers the Liu and Harbury/Halpin lineages; it does not claim invention of all DNA-encoded libraries.

candidates.discovery: Double-network hydrogels with high mechanical toughness
candidates.scientific_basis: Interpenetrating networks combine sacrificial damage and elastic support to toughen water-rich gels.
candidates.rationale: A clear molecular design principle for useful soft matter.
candidates.main_reservation: A compelling materials advance whose independently prize-sized significance is less established.
candidates.attribution_note: The 2003 original paper supports the pool; Katsuyama’s first-paper contribution must be reviewed before choosing a final trio.

candidates.discovery: Dye-sensitized nanocrystalline solar cells
candidates.scientific_basis: Molecular sensitizers inject electrons into nanocrystalline semiconductor networks.
candidates.rationale: An influential chemical route to converting light into electricity.
candidates.main_reservation: Commercial impact is smaller than silicon photovoltaics; competing newer solar technologies may draw attention.
candidates.attribution_note: The 1991 original paper directly supports both names.

candidates.discovery: Electrical reading of DNA and RNA through nanopores
candidates.scientific_basis: Sequence-dependent ionic currents report nucleic-acid passage through engineered pores.
candidates.rationale: A distinct single-molecule analytical platform.
candidates.main_reservation: Concept, pore engineering, enzyme control and commercial realization are distributed.
candidates.attribution_note: The retrospective by the pioneers supports a broad pool. John Kasianowicz and other contributors need consideration in a final priority audit.

candidates.discovery: Expansion and reprogramming of the genetic code
candidates.scientific_basis: Orthogonal translation components introduce chosen noncanonical amino acids into proteins.
candidates.rationale: A general route to new protein chemistry inside cells.
candidates.main_reservation: Directed evolution was rewarded in 2018; translational engineering needs a distinct citation.
candidates.attribution_note: The expanded eukaryotic-code paper supports both; additional early contributors should be reviewed for a final award.
prior_award_flags: Directed evolution: Chemistry 2018; distinguish orthogonal translation machinery

candidates.discovery: Expansion microscopy by chemical enlargement of specimens
candidates.scientific_basis: Molecules are anchored to a swellable polymer network that enlarges the specimen for imaging.
candidates.rationale: A specific chemical invention extending ordinary microscopes.
candidates.main_reservation: Young relative to many Nobel discoveries; related microscopy was rewarded in 2014.
candidates.attribution_note: The 2015 original paper supports all three; expansion chemistry is distinct from optical super-resolution.
prior_award_flags: Super-resolved fluorescence microscopy: Chemistry 2014; distinct specimen-expansion chemistry

candidates.discovery: Fast tetrazine ligation for molecular labeling
candidates.scientific_basis: Tetrazines react rapidly with strained alkenes in a bioorthogonal ligation.
candidates.rationale: A specific reaction with valuable labeling and delivery applications.
candidates.main_reservation: Bioorthogonal chemistry was rewarded in 2022; another award needs a demonstrably separate advance.
candidates.attribution_note: Fox and Blackman are the initial original-paper pool. Other independent tetrazine-ligation and pretargeting lineages require review for a broad claim.
prior_award_flags: Bioorthogonal chemistry: Chemistry 2022; substantial overlap

candidates.discovery: First-principles molecular dynamics by the Car-Parrinello method
candidates.scientific_basis: Electronic structure and atomic dynamics are evolved together to simulate chemical systems.
candidates.rationale: A foundational route to studying condensed matter and reactions from first principles.
candidates.main_reservation: Must distinguish it from DFT in 1998 and multiscale modeling in 2013.
candidates.attribution_note: The 1985 original paper directly supports the pair.
prior_award_flags: DFT: Chemistry 1998
Multiscale modeling: Chemistry 2013; distinct ab initio dynamics

candidates.discovery: Flexizyme and RaPID discovery of nonstandard cyclic peptides
candidates.scientific_basis: Artificial RNA catalysts charge tRNAs with diverse building blocks for translated peptide libraries.
candidates.rationale: A concrete chemistry invention enabling new molecular binders.
candidates.main_reservation: Shares translation engineering with genetic-code expansion; avoid counting it twice in a combined award.
candidates.attribution_note: The Wolf account supports Suga’s specific flexizyme and cyclic-peptide platform.

candidates.discovery: Gas-phase characterization of reactive species and catalytic mechanisms
candidates.scientific_basis: Isolated reactive ions and mechanistic analysis reveal elementary bond-activation chemistry.
candidates.rationale: Fundamental experiments connecting reactive species to catalysis.
candidates.main_reservation: The citation must identify a discrete contribution rather than all gas-phase reaction research.
candidates.attribution_note: Schwarz’s 2025 interview and Wolf recognition support inclusion; detailed experiment-level priority review is still needed.

candidates.discovery: Halide perovskite absorbers for high-efficiency solar cells
candidates.scientific_basis: Solution-processable halide perovskites act as efficient light absorbers and charge-transport materials.
candidates.rationale: A major new photovoltaic material platform.
candidates.main_reservation: Durability, lead management and attribution across early device architectures remain issues.
candidates.attribution_note: Separate Miyasaka’s early sensitizers, Park/Grätzel’s solid-state work and Snaith’s device advances before choosing three.

candidates.discovery: High-field dynamic nuclear polarization for sensitive NMR
candidates.scientific_basis: Electron polarization is transferred to nuclei to enhance high-field NMR sensitivity.
candidates.rationale: A broadly useful advance for structural and mechanistic chemistry.
candidates.main_reservation: DNP predates modern high-field implementations and has many technical contributors.
candidates.attribution_note: Griffin is the starting pool for the high-field advance; Temkin and polarizing-agent developers require review if their inventions enter the citation.

candidates.discovery: Hydrogel-based tissue clearing and molecular interrogation with CLARITY
candidates.scientific_basis: A stabilizing tissue-hydrogel hybrid enables lipid removal while preserving molecular features.
candidates.rationale: A chemical preparation method enabling intact-tissue molecular imaging.
candidates.main_reservation: Other tissue-clearing chemistries have different inventors; the award scope should stay narrow.
candidates.attribution_note: The original CLARITY author account supports this pair, not priority over every clearing method.

candidates.discovery: In vitro selection of ligand-binding nucleic-acid aptamers
candidates.scientific_basis: Iterative selection and amplification isolate nucleic acids with desired binding functions.
candidates.rationale: A general discovery method for functional molecular recognition.
candidates.main_reservation: Two independent founding papers and a previous laureate complicate the three-person choice.
candidates.attribution_note: Keep the Gold/Tuerk and Ellington/Szostak lineages separate during attribution review.
prior_award_flags: Szostak: Medicine 2009 for chromosome protection; distinct selection methodology

candidates.discovery: Intermolecular activation of unreactive alkane C-H bonds
candidates.scientific_basis: Reactive metal complexes cleave otherwise inert alkane carbon-hydrogen bonds.
candidates.rationale: A foundational change in what bonds synthetic chemistry can address.
candidates.main_reservation: The early discovery, catalytic utility and later selective transformations are different award scopes.
candidates.attribution_note: Bergman is a starting pool, not an exclusive priority conclusion; audit the Janowicz-Bergman and Graham lineages before shortlisting.

candidates.discovery: Ion confinement in subnanometer carbon pores for supercapacitors
candidates.scientific_basis: Very small pores alter ion adsorption and can increase charge-storage capacitance.
candidates.rationale: A chemical understanding of electrochemical energy storage beyond conventional pore models.
candidates.main_reservation: The invention and mechanism are distributed across experimental teams.
candidates.attribution_note: The original study supports this provisional pool; Yushin and Portet also require consideration if the 2006 result is the final citation.

candidates.discovery: Ionizable lipid nanoparticles for delivery of nucleic-acid medicines
candidates.scientific_basis: Lipid compositions package nucleic acids and promote their intracellular release.
candidates.rationale: An enabling chemical formulation platform for RNA medicines.
candidates.main_reservation: Academic and industrial credit is distributed and contested.
candidates.attribution_note: This pool emphasizes lipid-formulation pioneers. It is not a resolved priority judgment about vaccine products or a substitute for reviewing competing delivery lineages.
prior_award_flags: Modified mRNA discoveries: Medicine 2023; distinguish lipid delivery chemistry

candidates.discovery: Isolation and chemistry of stable carbenes
candidates.scientific_basis: Stabilized divalent carbon species can be isolated and used as ligands and reactive molecules.
candidates.rationale: A fundamental discovery that opened new catalyst chemistry.
candidates.main_reservation: Discovery and downstream NHC catalyst applications are not identical credit scopes.
candidates.attribution_note: Bertrand’s 1988 carbene and Arduengo’s crystalline NHC discovery should both be retained.

candidates.discovery: Kinetic stabilization of transthyretin to prevent amyloid disease
candidates.subfield: Protein physical chemistry and medicinal chemistry
candidates.scientific_basis: Small-molecule binding stabilizes native tetramers and suppresses amyloid-producing dissociation.
candidates.rationale: A precise physical-chemical mechanism translated into disease modification.
candidates.main_reservation: Medicine is plausible; the drug-development team and mechanistic discovery are different credit pools.
candidates.attribution_note: Kelly is the primary initial candidate; Powers is a mechanistic alternative. Review the original medicinal-chemistry team before adding a drug-development recipient.

candidates.discovery: Ligand- and template-controlled selective C-H functionalization
candidates.scientific_basis: Designed catalysts and templates control which C-H bond is transformed, including remote sites.
candidates.rationale: A general strategy for shorter and more selective molecular synthesis.
candidates.main_reservation: Broad C-H functionalization involves many independent groups; the citation must specify the selectivity invention.
candidates.attribution_note: Yu is the supported initial pool for this narrow scope. Hartwig, Sanford and other pioneers may be relevant to a broader award and need dedicated sources.

candidates.discovery: Light-gated microbial channels and optogenetic control
candidates.subfield: Photochemistry, protein engineering and chemical biology
candidates.scientific_basis: Microbial opsins translate illumination into controllable cellular electrical activity.
candidates.rationale: An influential molecular tool linking protein photochemistry to cell control.
candidates.main_reservation: Medicine is plausible; microbial-channel discovery and neuronal application require different attribution.
candidates.attribution_note: The Lasker account supports the scientific lineages but not a final four-person proposal. Nagel and Boyden are retained for discovery/application credit review.

candidates.discovery: Long-range electron transfer through proteins
candidates.scientific_basis: Engineered protein systems reveal how distance and molecular pathways govern electron movement.
candidates.rationale: A fundamental chemical mechanism underlying biological energy conversion.
candidates.main_reservation: Must identify experiments beyond the electron-transfer theory rewarded in 1992.
candidates.attribution_note: The 2026 Clarivate citation supports Gray and Winkler jointly.
prior_award_flags: Related theoretical foundation: Marcus, Chemistry 1992; distinct experimental citation required

candidates.discovery: Mass spectrometry methods for large-scale and quantitative proteomics
candidates.scientific_basis: Peptide separation, tandem MS, database matching and quantification characterize complex proteomes.
candidates.rationale: A mature analytical platform with field-wide consequences.
candidates.main_reservation: Many inventors underlie the workflow; three names require a clear methodological scope.
candidates.attribution_note: Aebersold/Mann and the Yates MudPIT work support the pool; consider Washburn and Wolters if MudPIT itself is cited.
prior_award_flags: Biological MS ionization: Chemistry 2002; distinguish proteomic workflows

candidates.discovery: Massively parallel next-generation DNA sequencing
candidates.scientific_basis: Parallel DNA amplification and sequencing chemistry allow very large numbers of fragments to be read.
candidates.rationale: A mature analytical invention that transformed genomics.
candidates.main_reservation: Sequencing has many platform inventors; narrow the award to the supported parallel-sequencing lineage.
candidates.attribution_note: The 2022 Breakthrough and 2026 Wolf awards support this trio; other sequencing technologies are separate entries.
prior_award_flags: Earlier DNA sequencing: Chemistry 1980; distinguish massively parallel methods

candidates.discovery: Metadynamics for rare events and chemical free-energy landscapes
candidates.scientific_basis: History-dependent bias enables escape from metastable states and reconstructs free energies.
candidates.rationale: A specific simulation invention used across chemistry.
candidates.main_reservation: May be viewed as an incremental computational method rather than an independently prize-sized discovery.
candidates.attribution_note: The 2002 original paper supports the pair; compare with, rather than double-count, first-principles dynamics.

candidates.discovery: Metal-directed self-assembly of discrete molecular cages
candidates.scientific_basis: Directional metal-ligand bonding assembles finite hosts and functional molecular cavities.
candidates.rationale: A chemical design principle for complex structures and confined reactions.
candidates.main_reservation: Close to supramolecular chemistry in 1987 and especially MOFs in 2025.
candidates.attribution_note: These leaders represent distinct discrete-cage approaches; the pool is not an established laureate trio.
prior_award_flags: Supramolecular chemistry: Chemistry 1987
MOFs: Chemistry 2025; finite cages need distinct scope

candidates.discovery: Molecular imaging of tissues by mass spectrometry
candidates.scientific_basis: Position-indexed mass spectra map molecular species within tissue sections.
candidates.rationale: A distinct way to connect chemical identity with spatial biology.
candidates.main_reservation: Uses ionization advances already rewarded and involves later independent platforms.
candidates.attribution_note: Caprioli is the initial pool; Farmer and Gile are original coauthors whose specific roles need priority review.
prior_award_flags: MS ionization: Chemistry 2002; distinguish molecular imaging

candidates.discovery: MXenes as a family of two-dimensional transition-metal carbides
candidates.scientific_basis: Selective removal of layers from MAX phases creates chemically tunable two-dimensional materials.
candidates.rationale: Discovery of a broad new material family.
candidates.main_reservation: Field growth is large, but established transformative applications are still developing.
candidates.attribution_note: Include first-author Naguib alongside the laboratory leaders; other early authors remain part of the priority audit.

candidates.discovery: Native chemical ligation and protein semisynthesis
candidates.scientific_basis: Chemoselective peptide ligation creates native backbone bonds and enables protein semisynthesis.
candidates.rationale: A general synthetic method for proteins with designed chemical modifications.
candidates.main_reservation: Native ligation and expressed protein ligation have distinct contributions.
candidates.attribution_note: The 1994 and 1998 papers support the pool. Ian Clark-Lewis’s coauthorship and contribution require historical-credit review.

candidates.discovery: Organic thin-film electroluminescent diodes
candidates.scientific_basis: Layered organic films provide efficient charge injection and light emission.
candidates.rationale: A molecular-materials invention with enormous practical use.
candidates.main_reservation: May fit Physics; a broader OLED citation competes for places with phosphorescence pioneers.
candidates.attribution_note: The 1987 paper supports Tang and Van Slyke; keep the later triplet-harvesting discovery explicit.

candidates.discovery: Palladium-catalyzed carbon-nitrogen cross-coupling
candidates.scientific_basis: Catalyst and ligand design make aryl amination broadly practical.
candidates.rationale: A widely used bond-forming method in drug and fine-chemical synthesis.
candidates.main_reservation: Related carbon-carbon cross-coupling was already rewarded in 2010.
candidates.attribution_note: The independent development of the broadly useful amination method supports the pair; Migita’s earlier chemistry remains historical priority context.
prior_award_flags: Carbon-carbon cross-coupling: Chemistry 2010; distinguish carbon-nitrogen method

candidates.discovery: Porous crystalline covalent organic frameworks
candidates.scientific_basis: Covalent bonds connect organic building blocks into ordered porous extended structures.
candidates.rationale: A chemically distinct class of crystalline porous materials.
candidates.main_reservation: Very close to the 2025 MOF prize and includes a 2025 laureate.
candidates.attribution_note: Use the original COF paper as a starting pool; retain only for explicit overlap review, not as an unqualified fresh reticular-chemistry forecast.
prior_award_flags: Yaghi: Chemistry 2025 for MOFs; very substantial scope and timing overlap

candidates.discovery: Predictive coupled-cluster methods in quantum chemistry
candidates.scientific_basis: Coupled excitation expansions provide accurate molecular energies, states and spectra.
candidates.rationale: A central method for quantitative electronic-structure prediction.
candidates.main_reservation: Key early molecular pioneers are deceased, and practical method development is distributed.
candidates.attribution_note: Bartlett is the initial recipient pool. The joint review with Musiał supports the scientific account but does not by itself establish a second recipient; additions need contribution-level evidence.

candidates.discovery: Programmable DNA base editing without double-strand cleavage
candidates.scientific_basis: Cas-targeted deaminase systems convert selected cytosine or adenine bases.
candidates.rationale: A distinct programmable chemical transformation of genomic DNA.
candidates.main_reservation: CRISPR recognition was rewarded in 2020; delivery and specificity remain limitations.
candidates.attribution_note: Komor led the cytosine-editor paper; Gaudelli led adenine-editor development. Credit both chemistries if the citation covers both.
prior_award_flags: CRISPR-Cas9 method: Chemistry 2020; distinguish deaminase editing

candidates.discovery: Programmable search-and-replace editing of genomic DNA
candidates.scientific_basis: A Cas nickase, reverse transcriptase and edit-encoding guide write changes into DNA.
candidates.rationale: A specific invention for substitutions and small insertions or deletions.
candidates.main_reservation: Younger than base editing and shares substantial engineering ancestry with CRISPR.
candidates.attribution_note: Anzalone and Liu are the initial pool from the 2019 paper; do not silently combine with the base-editor trio.
prior_award_flags: CRISPR-Cas9: Chemistry 2020; distinct reverse-transcription mechanism

candidates.discovery: Programmable targeted protein degradation with PROTACs
candidates.scientific_basis: Bifunctional compounds recruit a target protein to ubiquitin machinery for destruction.
candidates.rationale: A new intervention strategy beyond occupancy-based inhibition.
candidates.main_reservation: Clinical maturity and attribution between the original concept and drug-like degraders need assessment.
candidates.attribution_note: Keep Sakamoto and Kim visible from the original paper instead of preselecting laboratory leaders.
prior_award_flags: Ubiquitin-mediated degradation: Chemistry 2004; distinguish designed recruitment

candidates.discovery: Residual dipolar coupling methods for biomolecular NMR
candidates.scientific_basis: Weak alignment provides long-range orientational information beyond conventional solution NMR.
candidates.rationale: A specific structural method with broad biomolecular application.
candidates.main_reservation: NMR and protein NMR have already received multiple chemistry prizes.
candidates.attribution_note: The initial scope is residual dipolar coupling methodology, not all biomolecular NMR; original coauthors and alignment-medium inventors need final review.
prior_award_flags: NMR: Chemistry 1991 and protein NMR 2002; distinct residual-dipolar-coupling advance

candidates.discovery: Reversible addition-fragmentation chain-transfer polymerization
candidates.scientific_basis: Chain-transfer agents regulate radical growth to make polymers with controlled structures.
candidates.rationale: A robust synthesis platform with substantial industrial relevance.
candidates.main_reservation: A combined controlled-polymerization award would require choosing among more than three pioneers.
candidates.attribution_note: CSIRO supports this trio while identifying additional team inventors, including Chiefari and Meijs.

candidates.discovery: Reversible RNA methylation and the m6A regulatory system
candidates.scientific_basis: RNA modification enzymes and mapping methods reveal regulated methylation of messenger RNA.
candidates.rationale: A chemical layer of gene regulation with broad biological relevance.
candidates.main_reservation: Demethylation, mapping, readers and writers could support different citations.
candidates.attribution_note: He’s demethylation discovery and the independent Jaffrey/Meyer and Rechavi/Dominissini mapping lineages are alternatives; this is not a five-person award proposal.

candidates.discovery: Self-assembled monolayers for molecular control of surfaces
candidates.scientific_basis: Adsorbing molecular layers give surfaces designed chemical functionality.
candidates.rationale: Foundational surface engineering with broad uses.
candidates.main_reservation: A final priority review must distinguish silane monolayers from thiol monolayers and later applications.
candidates.attribution_note: The 2026 Clarivate award supports this pool; it does not establish actual Nobel nominations.

candidates.discovery: Semiconductor-driven photoelectrochemical splitting of water
candidates.scientific_basis: Illuminated semiconductor electrodes drive water oxidation and hydrogen production.
candidates.rationale: A founding discovery of semiconductor photocatalytic chemistry.
candidates.main_reservation: The original co-discoverer is deceased and large-scale solar fuel deployment remains limited.
candidates.attribution_note: The initial citation is the original photoelectrochemical discovery; do not automatically append later photocatalyst developers.

candidates.discovery: Single-molecule FRET for biomolecular conformations and dynamics
candidates.scientific_basis: Donor-acceptor fluorescence reports molecular distances and changes in individual molecules.
candidates.rationale: A broadly used method for observing molecular mechanisms hidden by averaging.
candidates.main_reservation: Must distinguish it from the single-molecule detection and super-resolution work rewarded in 2014.
candidates.attribution_note: The original 1996 authorship supports this provisional pool; do not treat author order as a definitive priority decision.
prior_award_flags: Super-resolved fluorescence microscopy: Chemistry 2014; distinct FRET distance/dynamics method

candidates.discovery: Single-molecule measurements of molecular motors and folding forces
candidates.scientific_basis: Force manipulation measures motor steps and the mechanical energetics of DNA, RNA and proteins.
candidates.rationale: A way to study chemical mechanisms one molecule at a time.
candidates.main_reservation: The optical-tweezers invention was rewarded in Physics 2018.
candidates.attribution_note: Use a narrow chemical-mechanism citation for the pioneering molecular experiments, rather than re-awarding the trap itself.
prior_award_flags: Optical tweezers: Physics 2018; distinguish molecular mechanistic discoveries

candidates.discovery: Small molecules inducing protein complexes to control signaling
candidates.scientific_basis: Immunophilin-drug complexes acquire partner-binding functions and alter signaling machinery.
candidates.rationale: A foundational chemical strategy for controlling protein interactions.
candidates.main_reservation: Immunosuppressive signaling, mTOR biology and modern degradation glues are different scopes.
candidates.attribution_note: The original calcineurin-complex lineage supports Schreiber and Liu; a broader induced-dimerization award needs a fresh priority review.

candidates.discovery: Spatially barcoded transcriptome measurement in tissue
candidates.scientific_basis: Position-barcoded capture chemistry retains tissue coordinates during RNA sequencing.
candidates.rationale: A new dimension in molecular measurement of tissue organization.
candidates.main_reservation: Many independent spatial methods and a large invention team complicate priority.
candidates.attribution_note: This pool covers the 2016 spatial-transcriptomics platform, including first authors; MERFISH and other spatial methods require separate attribution if merged.

candidates.discovery: Stimulated Raman scattering microscopy for chemical imaging
candidates.scientific_basis: Stimulated vibrational signals provide fast imaging with molecular chemical contrast.
candidates.rationale: A broadly useful method for observing chemical composition without conventional fluorescent labels.
candidates.main_reservation: Several coherent Raman microscopy lineages and instrument contributions require review.
candidates.attribution_note: The 2008 SRS paper supports this pool, including its first authors; do not extend it to all Raman microscopy.

candidates.discovery: Strategies for total synthesis of complex bioactive natural products
candidates.scientific_basis: New reaction and assembly strategies enable synthesis of highly complex biologically active molecules.
candidates.rationale: An influential synthetic tradition linking molecular construction to biological function.
candidates.main_reservation: This is a broad program rather than a single invention; a Nobel citation should name a specific strategy or coherent set of breakthroughs.
candidates.attribution_note: Keep the two established synthesis leaders for breadth, not as an established joint-award proposal. A specific target citation would require reviewing competing synthesis teams.

candidates.discovery: Structural and catalytic mechanisms of the spliceosome
candidates.scientific_basis: Structures across splicing states reveal rearrangements and the RNA-based catalytic center.
candidates.rationale: Chemical explanation of a large RNA-processing molecular machine.
candidates.main_reservation: A key pioneer is deceased; biochemical discovery and recent structural work have different credit histories.
candidates.attribution_note: Shi and Lührmann represent major structural programs; Nguyen represents early structural work in Nagai’s lineage. Final attribution remains open.
prior_award_flags: Catalytic RNA: Chemistry 1989
Cryo-EM methods: Chemistry 2017; distinguish splicing-machine mechanism

candidates.discovery: Structural mechanisms of eukaryotic transcription machinery
candidates.scientific_basis: Structures and functional experiments explain assembly and operation of gene-transcribing complexes.
candidates.rationale: Mechanistic chemistry of a fundamental molecular machine.
candidates.main_reservation: Transcription was already rewarded in Chemistry 2006 and cryo-EM in 2017.
candidates.attribution_note: The Shaw account supports the pair; specify later regulatory and initiation mechanisms beyond the previously rewarded polymerase work.
prior_award_flags: Transcription: Chemistry 2006
Cryo-EM methods: Chemistry 2017; substantial scope overlap

candidates.discovery: Supported single-atom catalysts
candidates.scientific_basis: Isolated supported metal atoms supply defined active sites and efficient metal utilization.
candidates.rationale: A major bridge between molecular and heterogeneous catalyst design.
candidates.main_reservation: Earlier isolated-site catalysts and the multiple roles in the 2011 discovery require priority review.
candidates.attribution_note: The original paper supports the wider pool; Clarivate 2025 recognized Zhang alone and should not erase co-discoverers.

candidates.discovery: Template-directed ordered mesoporous silica
candidates.scientific_basis: Surfactant and block-copolymer templates produce ordered silica with designed mesoscale pores.
candidates.rationale: A new synthesis principle for organized porous solids.
candidates.main_reservation: MCM-41 and SBA-15 are distinct developments with more than three major contributors.
candidates.attribution_note: Kresge/Beck represent MCM-41; Stucky/Zhao represent SBA-15. Choose a coherent citation before reducing the pool.

candidates.discovery: Triplet harvesting in phosphorescent organic light-emitting devices
candidates.scientific_basis: Organometallic emitters harvest triplet excitations otherwise lost in fluorescent OLEDs.
candidates.rationale: A specific chemical mechanism that substantially improved device efficiency.
candidates.main_reservation: Cannot simply bundle all OLED pioneers within three recipients; Physics is also plausible.
candidates.attribution_note: The 1998 original paper supports this pool, including first author Baldo.

candidates.discovery: Tunable plasmonic nanoshells and nanoscale light-matter design
candidates.scientific_basis: Metal-shell geometry controls optical resonances and local electromagnetic interactions.
candidates.rationale: A platform connecting molecular-scale materials design with optical functions.
candidates.main_reservation: Physics is plausible; a broad applications citation needs stronger priority definition.
candidates.attribution_note: Halas represents experimental nanoshell design and Nordlander the supporting plasmonic theory; the original experimental coauthors need final review.

candidates.discovery: Two-dimensional infrared spectroscopy of molecular structure and dynamics
candidates.scientific_basis: Correlated vibrational excitations reveal couplings and rapidly evolving molecular structures.
candidates.rationale: A major way to examine dynamics with structural specificity.
candidates.main_reservation: The founding senior pioneer is deceased and ultrafast spectroscopy has Nobel precedent.
candidates.attribution_note: Hamm and Zanni represent early and later method development; Hochstrasser must retain historical credit.
prior_award_flags: Femtochemistry: Chemistry 1999; distinguish multidimensional structural spectroscopy

candidates.discovery: Visible-light photoredox catalysis for organic synthesis
candidates.scientific_basis: Light-excited catalysts generate reactive intermediates by electron transfer under mild conditions.
candidates.rationale: A widely adopted reaction platform with new synthetic disconnections.
candidates.main_reservation: Earlier photoredox precedents and a previous laureate require careful citation and credit allocation.
candidates.attribution_note: The early modern independent studies support Yoon and Stephenson; Nicewicz’s contribution must be considered alongside MacMillan. The interview feature is supporting context, not a priority adjudication.
prior_award_flags: MacMillan: Chemistry 2021 for asymmetric organocatalysis; possible distinct achievement

candidates.discovery: Vitrimers with exchangeable permanent polymer networks
candidates.scientific_basis: Associative bond exchange enables permanent networks to flow and be reshaped.
candidates.rationale: A chemical design concept for reprocessable thermoset-like materials.
candidates.main_reservation: Industrial impact is developing and adaptable networks have prior precedents.
candidates.attribution_note: The 2011 original paper supports this provisional pool; Capelot’s contribution also needs consideration.
